name: GitHub, Inbox
description: Every open issue, pull request and discussion across the repos you own, in one list. Grouped by repo or by kind, newest activity first or oldest first. Pick repos to leave out, or exclude by pattern (tesserae-widget-*). Add orgs to cover their repos too. Issues and PRs work without a token; discussions need a PAT in Plugins → GitHub Core.

cell_options.name: user
cell_options.label: Username
cell_options.help: Blank uses the username set in GitHub Core.

cell_options.name: show_discussions
cell_options.label: Discussions
cell_options.help: Needs a token in GitHub Core.

cell_options.name: max_items
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Rows shown. Rows that do not fit the cell are counted in a +N more footer.

cell_options.name: extra_owners
cell_options.label: Also include
cell_options.help: Orgs or users whose repos join the list, separated by commas.

cell_options.name: exclude_repos
cell_options.label: Leave out
cell_options.help: Repos to skip, picked from your own.

cell_options.name: exclude_patterns
cell_options.label: Also leave out
cell_options.help: Repo names separated by commas, with * as a wildcard, for example tesserae-widget-*.

choices.label: Oldest first (the stale ones on top)

cell_options.name: show_labels
cell_options.label: Labels
cell_options.help: The issue and PR labels on each row.
